title: Billing, Cost Hygiene, and FinOps Architecture — D6
purpose: Shows the documented internals needed to predict behavior; undocumented details are observed behavior and may change.
routing_rationale: Cost tracking relies on decoupled event streaming. Billing data is continuously streamed into BigQuery for SQL analytics, while budget monitors trigger Pub/Sub automations.

nodes.label: Master Billing Account
nodes.detail: Consolidates payments, committed use discounts, and project associations.

nodes.label: Detailed Export Stream
nodes.detail: Streams resource usage, labels, and pricing data directly into BigQuery daily.

nodes.label: BigQuery FinOps Dataset
nodes.detail: Stores partitioned raw usage data for Looker Studio unit-cost dashboards.

nodes.label: Budget Alert Rule (80% / 100%)
nodes.detail: Monitors monthly forecast; publishes threshold events to Pub/Sub topic.

nodes.label: Cloud Function Cost Capper
nodes.detail: Automated remediation: revokes billing permissions or downsizes dev MIGs on 100% breach.

steps.title: Billing Stream Ingestion
steps.action: Cloud Billing pushes hourly usage and SKU costs directly to BigQuery.
steps.why_traversal: Provides granular, SQL-queryable visibility into cost drivers without manual exports.

steps.title: Budget Threshold Trigger
steps.action: Cloud Budgets evaluates projected spend; detects spend crossing 100% allocation.
steps.why_traversal: Continuous automated evaluation prevents unexpected end-of-month cloud bills.

steps.title: Automated Remediation
steps.action: Budget publishes event to Pub/Sub; Cloud Function scales non-critical instances to zero.
steps.why_traversal: Immediate programmatic intervention caps unbounded expenditure during runaways.

scenarios.label: Uncapped BigQuery Query Scan Spike
scenarios.root_cause: Developer script executed full scan on 50TB unpartitioned table repeatedly.
scenarios.diverted_path: Spend spikes $250/hour; budget alert fires notification within 30 minutes.
scenarios.blast_radius: Development project budget consumed in 4 hours.
scenarios.recovery: Set BigQuery maximum_bytes_billed per query; enforce partitioned and clustered tables.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
